summary: Full E2E testing of CareerTrack. Backend: 13/13 pytest tests passed (auth register/login/logout/me, applications CRUD, validation, analytics reflect new data, data isolation between users, no _id leakage). Frontend: All requested flows verified via Playwright — register->dashboard, topbar logout->/login, protected /applications redirect, demo login (10 seeded apps), 4 KPI cards + 3 charts visible, cookie session persists on refresh, add-application with TBD toggle + optional fields, empty-form validation error, search filter, status filter chip (Offer), edit updates fields on card, dashboard total/compensation chart reflect newly created app (10->11, TESTCO bar visible), delete with confirm dialog removes app, company logo image renders for known domain (google.com). Data isolation confirmed at API level.

issues: Recharts logs 'width(-1) height(-1)' warnings for the 3 chart containers on initial mount when data is empty/loading; harmless but noisy in console

action_items: Optional: silence Recharts width/height warnings by giving ResponsiveContainer parents an explicit min-height while loading (cosmetic).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: SESSION cookie samesite='none' + secure=True is correct for cross-site preview; verified.
server.py: _annualize does not handle 'weekly'/other unknown periods — currently silently falls through to raw amount; enum-validate pay_period in Pydantic to be safe.
server.py: analytics volume slicing uses last 8 sorted months; if user has gaps between months the line chart will connect distant months (minor UX).
ApplicationForm.jsx: 'form-day-applied' uses browser-native <input type='date'> instead of the shadcn Calendar component — acceptable but inconsistent with dark theme; picker UI is browser default.
Applications.jsx: Edit/Delete buttons hidden until row hover (opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100) — poor discoverability on touch devices; consider always visible or focus-visible.
Applications.jsx: `load()` has no error handling — API failure will leave loading state indefinitely.
seed_data_creation: During testing: created and deleted ephemeral 'TESTCO_*' applications on the demo user; also created several 'test_<rand>@example.com' users via register flow (persist in DB). Demo user data intact (10 seeded apps remain).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and can be re-run with: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v. Playwright frontend flow (register/logout/protected route/demo login/CRUD/search/filter/edit/delete/analytics-update/logos) all worked end-to-end against the public preview URL.
rca of the issue: None. No functional bugs found. Only cosmetic Recharts warnings and minor code-quality suggestions.
